name: gizza-ai/ssh-public-key-from-private
summary: Derive the OpenSSH public key (.pub line) from a private key

tool.description: Derive the OpenSSH PUBLIC key (the single-line id_*.pub / authorized_keys format, e.g. 'ssh-rsa AAAA... user@host') from a PRIVATE key. The offline equivalent of 'ssh-keygen -y'. Supports RSA, EC (NIST P-256/P-384) and Ed25519 private keys as PEM or raw DER (hex/base64); optional trailing comment.
